VERIDION TECHNOLOGIES LLC
Management Pack – Statement of Profit or Loss
Reporting Period: Quarter ended 30 September 2026
Document Status: Final management pack (unaudited) – supersedes version 1.
Prepared Date: 18 October 2026.
Reporting Currency: AED.
1. Statement of Profit or Loss
All monetary amounts are expressed in AED units.
Financial Metric Q3 2026
Revenue 12,500,000
Direct Operating
(7,250,000)
Costs
Gross Profit 5,250,000
Operating Expenses (2,850,000)
Operating Profit 2,400,000
Finance Costs (150,000)
Profit Before Tax 2,250,000
Corporate Tax (9%) (202,500)
Net Profit 2,047,500
The above figures represent actual financial results for the completed third quarter.
2. Historical Financial Performance
All monetary amounts are expressed in AED thousands.
Financial Indicator FY 2024 FY 2025
Revenue 35,500 42,750
Net Profit 5,250 7,850
Intelligent Infrastructure Recovery Benefits 450 725

Automated Service Optimization Savings 280 460
3. Actual and Budget Comparison
Reporting Period: Q3 2026.
All monetary amounts are expressed in AED units.
Financial Metric Actual Budget
850,00 950,00
Capital Expenditure
0 0
325,00 400,00
Marketing Expenses
0 0
Research and Development 475,00 500,00
Expenses 0 0
4. Cash Position
Veridion Technologies LLC reported closing cash of AED 2,750,000 as at 30 September 2026,
against a minimum operating cash requirement of AED 3,200,000, resulting in a cash shortfall of
AED 450,000.
Customer collections totaling AED 625,000 were received on 12 October 2026.
The company paid AED 175,000 for equipment maintenance on 25 September 2026, earlier
than originally budgeted.
Management forecasts closing cash of AED 4,100,000 as at 31 December 2026.
5. Financial and Operational Indicators
Reporting Period: Q3 2026.
Monetary amounts are expressed in AED units.
Indicator Value
Net Profit Margin 16.38%
Current Ratio 2.45
Debt-to-Equity Ratio 1.25
Total Employees 320
Outstanding 1,850,00
Receivables 0

Foreign Exchange Gain 0
Deferred Tax Adjustment N/A
6. International Financial Operations
Organization Financial Metric Period Currency Amount
Elvion Digital Services Revenue FY 2025 INR 16.5 crore
1.250.450,7
Norvexa Industries Capital Expenditure FY 2025 EUR
5
Q3
Trevanta Systems Operating Profit USD 425,750.50
2026
Maintenance
Elvion Digital Services FY 2025 INR 75 lakh
Expenses
7. Financial Commentary
Veridion Technologies LLC
During Q3 2026, Veridion Technologies LLC recognized autonomous infrastructure efficiency
gains of AED 350,000 and sustainable resource recovery benefits of AED 225,000.
Its administrative expenses amounted to AED 2026 during the same quarter.
Service delivery volumes increased by 12.5% compared with Q2 2026.
Norvexa Industries
Infrastructure modernization expenditure of EUR 850.250,50 was incurred by Norvexa
Industries during FY 2025.
The company also reported equipment recovery benefits of EUR 125.000,75 during the same
financial year.
8. Forecast and Target Performance
Entity: Veridion Technologies LLC.
Currency: AED units.
Q4 2026
Financial Indicator Q4 2026 Target
Forecast
Revenue 14,500,000 15,500,000

Net Profit 2,500,000 2,850,000
9. Revision Notes
1. This version supersedes version 1 dated 10 October 2026.
2. September revenue increased by AED 275,000 compared with the previous draft
following completion of customer invoicing. This adjustment is already included in the
reported quarterly revenue.
3. The current document was finalized on 18 October 2026.
10. Administrative Information
Veridion Technologies LLC was established in 1998.
Document Version: 2.0.
Internal Reference Number: 78452.
The next management meeting is scheduled for 25 November 2026.
The new regional office is expected to open in February 2027.
